figs.name: cascode-amplifier-bjt-circuit-diagram
figs.alt: cascode amplifier BJT circuit with common emitter Q1 and common base Q2 stages
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a BJT cascode amplifier: common emitter Q1 driving the emitter of common base Q2, with load Rc, bias and output at the Q2 collector.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>BJT cascode amplifier circuit with common emitter and common base stages</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">BJT Cascode Amplifier Circuit</text>
<line x1="240" y1="70" x2="420" y2="70" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="330" y="62" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">+Vcc</text>
<line x1="330" y1="70" x2="330" y2="90" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="318" y="90" width="24" height="60" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="300" y="126" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Rc</text>
<line x1="330" y1="150" x2="330" y2="214" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="330" cy="180" r="5" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<line x1="330" y1="180" x2="450" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="455" cy="180" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="470" y="186" font-size="19" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Vout</text>
<circle cx="310" cy="245" r="34" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="300" y1="225" x2="300" y2="265" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="300" y1="237" x2="330" y2="215" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="300" y1="253" x2="328" y2="275" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="360" y="251" font-size="20" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Q2, CB stage</text>
<line x1="330" y1="275" x2="330" y2="335" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="330" cy="305" r="5" fill="#1a2b4a"/>
<line x1="300" y1="245" x2="200" y2="245" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="190" y="240" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Vbias</text>
<text x="190" y="264" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">AC ground</text>
<circle cx="310" cy="365" r="34" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="300" y1="345" x2="300" y2="385" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="300" y1="357" x2="330" y2="335" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="300" y1="373" x2="328" y2="395" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="360" y="371" font-size="20" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Q1, CE stage</text>
<line x1="330" y1="395" x2="330" y2="460" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="300" y1="460" x2="360" y2="460" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="310" y1="468" x2="350" y2="468" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="320" y1="476" x2="340" y2="476" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="300" y1="365" x2="200" y2="365" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="195" cy="365" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="180" y="371" font-size="19" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Vin</text>
<line x1="336" y1="305" x2="470" y2="305" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="470" y="285" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="620.0" y="314.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Q1 collector sees 1/gm2</text>
<text x="620.0" y="337.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">gain of Q1 is about 1</text>
<rect x="470" y="395" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="620.0" y="424.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Q1 turns Vin into current</text>
<text x="620.0" y="447.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Q2 turns it into Vout</text>
<text x="160" y="520" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Av ≈ minus gm × Rc</text>
<text x="410" y="520" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Rout ≈ β × rce2</text>
<text x="640" y="520" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cin ≈ 2 × Cbc</text>
<text x="400" y="555" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Low swing at Q1 collector removes the Miller multiplication of Cbc</text>
</svg>

figs.name: cascode-amplifier-worked-example-flowchart
figs.alt: cascode amplifier calculation flowchart for gm, voltage gain, Miller capacitance and bandwidth
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog working the cascode example step by step: gm 38.5 mA/V, gain 385, input capacitance falling from 772 pF to 4 pF.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Cascode amplifier worked example calculation flowchart</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cascode Worked Example, Step by Step</text>
<rect x="150" y="56" width="500" height="56" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="90.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Given: IC = 1 mA, β = 100, Rc = 10 kΩ, Cbc = 2 pF</text>
<line x1="400" y1="112" x2="400" y2="133" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="135" width="680" height="64" rx="12" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="98" cy="167" r="20" fill="#be123c"/>
<text x="98" y="174" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="132" y="163" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Transconductance</text>
<text x="132" y="187" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">gm = IC / VT = 0.001 / 0.026 = 38.5 mA/V</text>
<line x1="400" y1="199" x2="400" y2="221" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="223" width="680" height="64" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="98" cy="255" r="20" fill="#be123c"/>
<text x="98" y="262" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="132" y="251" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Voltage gain</text>
<text x="132" y="275" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Av = gm × Rc = 385 V/V  (51.7 dB)</text>
<line x1="400" y1="287" x2="400" y2="309" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="311" width="680" height="64" rx="12" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="98" cy="343" r="20" fill="#be123c"/>
<text x="98" y="350" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="132" y="339" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Without cascode</text>
<text x="132" y="363" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Cin = (1 + 385) × 2 pF = 772 pF</text>
<line x1="400" y1="375" x2="400" y2="397" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="399" width="680" height="64" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="98" cy="431" r="20" fill="#be123c"/>
<text x="98" y="438" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="132" y="427" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">With cascode</text>
<text x="132" y="451" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Cin ≈ 2 × 2 pF = 4 pF</text>
<line x1="400" y1="463" x2="400" y2="485" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="487" width="680" height="64" rx="12" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#be123c" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="98" cy="519" r="20" fill="#be123c"/>
<text x="98" y="526" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
<text x="132" y="515" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Bandwidth gain</text>
<text x="132" y="539" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">772 pF / 4 pF ≈ 193 times wider</text>
<text x="400" y="578" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Gain stays the same as one CE stage; only Cin and bandwidth change</text>
</svg>

figs.name: cascode-amplifier-bjt-vs-mosfet-infographic
figs.alt: BJT cascode vs MOSFET cascode comparison of stages, output resistance and input capacitance
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing BJT and MOSFET cascode amplifiers: input and output stages, output resistance, input capacitance, headroom and typical uses.
figs.after_h2: BJT Cascode vs MOSFET Cascode: Key Differences
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>BJT cascode vs MOSFET cascode comparison chart</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">BJT Cascode vs MOSFET Cascode</text>
<rect x="30" y="60" width="740" height="50" rx="10" fill="#be123c"/>
<text x="140" y="92" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Parameter</text>
<text x="395" y="92" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">BJT cascode</text>
<text x="650" y="92" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">MOSFET cascode</text>
<rect x="30" y="110" width="740" height="62" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#fecdd3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="45" y="148" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Input stage</text>
<text x="395" y="148" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Common emitter Q1</text>
<text x="650" y="148" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Common source M1</text>
<rect x="30" y="172" width="740" height="62" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#fecdd3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="45" y="210" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Output stage</text>
<text x="395" y="210" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Common base Q2</text>
<text x="650" y="210" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Common gate M2</text>
<rect x="30" y="234" width="740" height="62" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#fecdd3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="45" y="272" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Output resistance</text>
<text x="395" y="272" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">β × rce2</text>
<text x="650" y="272" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">gm2 × rds2 × rds1</text>
<rect x="30" y="296" width="740" height="62" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#fecdd3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="45" y="334" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Input capacitance</text>
<text x="395" y="334" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">≈ 2 × Cbc</text>
<text x="650" y="334" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">≈ Cgs + 2 × Cgd</text>
<rect x="30" y="358" width="740" height="62" fill="#fff1f2" stroke="#fecdd3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="45" y="396" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Headroom</text>
<text x="395" y="396" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">two VBE, about 1.4 V</text>
<text x="650" y="396" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">two VGS drops</text>
<rect x="30" y="420" width="740" height="62" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#fecdd3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="45" y="458" font-size="18" fill="#9f1239" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Typical use</text>
<text x="395" y="458" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">IF and wideband amps</text>
<text x="650" y="458" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">RF LNA, CMOS op amps</text>
<line x1="260" y1="110" x2="260" y2="482" stroke="#fecdd3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<line x1="530" y1="110" x2="530" y2="482" stroke="#fecdd3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="400" y="525" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Both versions remove the Miller effect; MOSFET gives the higher Rout</text>
</svg>
